title: Subculture of Differentiated Blood-Brain Barrier Endothelial Cells
author: Ethan Lippmann
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8g5hty6

steps.title: Coat Plates or Filters
steps.instruction: Prepare the growth surface using ECM solution based on the chosen vessel type.

substeps.instruction: For plates: Coat with ECM plate solution for at least 1 hour at 37 °C. For overnight coating, add the necessary volume of ECM and an equal volume of ddH2O to prevent evaporation. Glass plates require overnight incubation.
For Transwell filters: Coat with 200 µL of ECM filter solution.

steps.title: Dry Coated Surfaces
steps.instruction: Aspirate the coating solution and allow surfaces to dry in a sterile hood with the lid slightly ajar.

substeps.instruction: Plates: Dry for 5 minutes (can be done during accutase incubation); do not over-dry.
Filters: Dry for 20 to 30 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare Cells for Dissociation
steps.instruction: Retrieve cells from the incubator and prepare the collection tubes.

substeps.instruction: Transfer a volume of spent media to a 15 ml conical tube equal to the number of wells being processed (e.g., 4 ml for 4 wells) and discard the remaining media.
Wash each well once with 2 mL PBS.

steps.title: Dissociate Cells with Accutase
steps.instruction: Apply accutase and incubate at 37 °C to detach cells.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL of accutase (warmed to room temperature) to each well.
Incubate at 37 °C. If cells were treated with RA, incubate for 20–45 minutes. If not treated with RA, incubate for 20 minutes or until dissociated (do not exceed 20 minutes).

steps.title: Prepare Filters (If Applicable)
steps.instruction: While cells are incubating in accutase, prepare the Transwell filters.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.5 mL hESFM to the top of each filter for 5 minutes to wet them, then aspirate the hESFM.
Add 1.5 mL EC medium (with or without 10 µM RA) to the basolateral chamber of each filter.

steps.title: Collect and Harvest Cells
steps.instruction: Collect the dissociated cells and concentrate them via centrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Use a p1000 pipette to collect cells, spraying gently over the surface 2–3 times to dislodge remaining cells.
Triturate briefly to break up cell clumps.
Transfer cells to the 15 ml conical tube containing the saved spent media.
Centrifuge (spin down) cells at 1000 rpm for 4 minutes.

steps.title: Resuspend and Seed Cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend cells in EC media (with or without 10 µM RA) and seed onto the prepared surfaces.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate media and resuspend cells in the appropriate volume of EC media.
For plates: Use split ratios (6-well to 6-well [1:1]; 6-well to 12-well [1:3]) or seed 1 million cells/cm² for smaller plates (24-, 48-, or 96-wells).
For filters: Use a 1:3 ratio (1 well of a 6-well plate seeds 3 filters). Total volume = # of 6-well plate wells * 0.5 mL (e.g., 1.5 mL for 3 filters).
Triturate 3–4 times to ensure a single-cell suspension.
Add the appropriate volume of cells to each well/filter.
Place in the incubator, shaking the plate back and forth to distribute cells evenly (do not swirl).

steps.title: Perform Media Change
steps.instruction: Replace the medium 24 hours later (Day 7) with medium lacking bFGF and RA to allow the monolayer to tighten.

substeps.instruction: For plates: Aspirate spent media and add the appropriate volume of EC medium without bFGF and RA.

For filters: Aspirate EC media from both chambers (do not touch the monolayer with the pipette tip). Gently add 0.5 mL of EC medium (lacking bFGF and RA) to the top chamber and 1.5 mL to the bottom chamber.
